text:
ake: Heads-up: after last night's edge rollout some customers report rapid WS reconnects on streaming routes. Pattern: server emits lots of 10-40B frames, clients see 1006 and reconnect immediately, which ends up double-counting in billing.

ravi: which route and region? any recent proxy flags changed?

ake: /v1/stream/reply (eu-central). We flipped an http2 write-flush optimization in the proxy. Direct-to-runtime doesn't reproduce.

emily: raw proxy snippet shows tiny gzipped fragments arriving as separate writes. client logs: ws.onclose code=1006 then reconnect().

jules: two possible mitigations: revert the flush change (broad impact) or buffer/coalesce tiny writes in proxy. Coalesce seems less risky but could add a few ms tail latency.

ravi: Ops asks for visibility first. Can we emit metrics: stream.small_frame_rate and stream.reconnect_rate (labels: route, tenant)? Also add a console tile on the route page to surface tiny-frame spikes.

ake: good idea. For coalesce behavior we should make it opt-in per route via a console flag and a CLI toggle for fast rollback. Heuristic proposal: buffer up to 64B or 40ms, but never coalesce single-byte heartbeats (
 or ). If buffer contents are valid UTF-8/JSON forward early.

emily: prototyped in staging (64B/40ms) - reconnects for test clients dropped from ~16/min to ~2/min, p95 latency +8ms. We're holding canary for 90m.

ravi: UX: console route page needs a "Stream health" card: tiny-frame count, reconnect rate, coalesce_latency_ms, impacted tenant ids. Add traces that mark when coalescing occurred.

jules: privacy note: telemetry must not include raw payloads. Send only hash + length + small_frame boolean.

ops-bot: deploy: edge-proxy/staging canary c-110 started 2026-03-23T11:45:00Z.

emily: PR opened, includes CLI flag --proxy-coalesce-small-frames and unit tests.

ake: follow-ups: @emily keep canary running and post numbers, @ravi add metrics and console card, @jules add rollback checklist to runbook.

ravi: will prototype dashboard widgets and set an alert on reconnect_rate spike > 5x baseline for 5m.

emily: staging after 60m: reconnects down, coalesce_latency_ms p50=6ms p95=18ms. Holding 30 more minutes before wider rollout.

ake: thanks team. If staging holds, let's plan a staged rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with manual holds and dashboard checks between steps.

jules: added runbook note about checking billing exports for duplicate stream sessions and how to issue credits if necessary.

emily: will also add a short blurb in release notes: "Mitigation for micro-frame reconnects in streaming paths (opt-in proxy coalescing)."

ake: I'll update when we start 10% step.
